reason: The primitive tetragonal cell (a approximately 9.1492 A, c approximately 6.6714 A) is strongly supported by indexing, and Z=2 is chemically plausible, but exact structure recovery is not established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied; the submitted models were selected mainly with an extracted-line intensity/cosine objective, and conspicuous intensity discrepancies remain. More decisively, selected.cif is physically impossible, with contacts including Sm-Sm 0.299 A, Ca-Ca 1.482 A, B-O 0.646 A, and many O-O contacts below 1.3 A. alternative-1.cif is also nonphysical, including Sm-B 1.500 A, B-B 1.367 A, O-O 1.399 A, and no normal approximately 1.3-1.6 A B-O coordination. The trajectory explicitly found that physical restraints substantially worsened the diffraction objective, yet it submitted these two coordinate minima; the alternative is the same P422 Wyckoff topology rather than a materially independent solution. P422 itself is not uniquely supported: charge-flip trials gave comparable or lower residuals for P4/mmm, P4mm, and other tetragonal choices, while detailed direct-space optimization was confined to P422. Thus the evidence supports the cell and at most a tentative heavy-atom intensity topology, not Z independently, the submitted symmetry, coordinates, borate framework, occupancies/order, or resolution of discrete alternatives. A scientifically different, chemically constrained structure solution and genuine whole-profile refinement could plausibly improve the candidate set, so another attempt is warranted.
